author: TeIq
content:
**Scope.** REQ-9 + AC-10. Polaris ingests labels from configured upstream labelers and turns them into `Observation { kind: ExternalLabel { ... } }` rows attached to the matching subject, weighted by operator-configured trust per upstream × category.

**Deliverables.**
- Migration: `upstream_labelers (did, hostname, signing_pubkey, weights JSONB)` — operator-configured.
- `polaris-backend/src/ingest/upstream_labels.rs`: one task per upstream, connecting to `wss://<upstream>/xrpc/com.atproto.label.subscribeLabels`.
- Signature verification against upstream's declared signing key (looked up via their `app.bsky.labeler.service` record, cached).
- Verified labels become `Observation { kind: ExternalLabel { source, label_value, weight }, evidence }` rows.
- Subject's denormalized `risk_signals` recomputed on observation insert.
- Trust weights resolved per-upstream × per-category at observation creation time; weight model captured so the §10 richer trust model can plug in later.

**References.**
- `.design/polaris-proto-blue-integration.md` REQ-9, AC-10, §G.
- design.md §5.9 (labeler interop), §10 (cross-labeler trust model open question — narrower trust model lives here, richer model deferred).

**Rust-quality.**
- One task per upstream (`tokio::spawn`); failures isolated.
- Backoff with jitter on reconnect; never tight-loops on a dead upstream.
- Signature verification is mandatory; an unsigned or wrong-signature label is dropped with a `tracing::warn!` and a metric.
- Cache invalidation: upstream signing key cache has TTL + manual-refresh endpoint.

**Testing.**
- AC-10: an inbound `Label` becomes an `Observation` attached to the right subject within 5s; signature verification round-trips.
- Reconnect: a forced disconnect resumes without label loss.

**Done when.** AC-10 passes; inbound labels surface in subject risk signals on the dashboard.
